behavior: Per-write opaque output qualifications are held in an adapter staging set; the strict finalizer requires exact current-generation identity coverage.
Qualification identities move into dx_data only after the DXF output transaction commits. A refused strict attempt leaves the published qualification set/count unchanged.
Connected only existing complete output/readback proofs for standard objects, associative variables, associative network/dictionary graphs, and dimension-dependency/body/constraint-group graphs.
A successful scratch legacy export publishes 71 unique callback identity qualifications. The strict attempt stages the same 71, refuses at 71/228, and publishes none.
limitations: The 71/228 count is a source-bound conversion proof count, not a format support or semantic acceptance claim.
The remaining 157 identities have no complete output qualification. The largest unqualified witnessed family is 54 ACDBASSOCGEOMDEPENDENCY records.
No ACDBASSOCGEOMDEPENDENCY output proof was inferred from the separate dimension-dependency graph proof.
